scope: Agency and appeal-stage filing instructions. Local application tests and simulated user journeys.
behavior: A required provision is shown as an official filing instruction. Retired legal research keys are excluded from search, model questions, drafting context and recovery.
A compulsory packet requirement still blocks submission until fulfilled. Conflicting official wording retains a source link for each passage.
Historic v2-v4 tier evaluations retain their original wire representation. Reassessment applies current procedure-only rules.

verification.backend_command: PB_PROVIDER_MODE=preview uv run --offline --with pytest-xdist pytest -n 4 --dist worksteal --tb=short (disk-backed TMPDIR)
verification.backend_static_checks: Ruff lint and format and strict mypy passed
verification.frontend_checks: TypeScript and ESLint passed. Checked-in OpenAPI matched the application schema.
verification.dedicated_rules_browser_test: Exact source link, issuer and review stage, unknown wording and historical-code suppression passed.
verification.offline_qualification: Research routing and vision campaign self-tests passed; neither called a provider.

limits: Browser paths used fake providers. National filing accuracy, physical-device coverage and a production end-to-end case remain unqualified.
verification_notes: An earlier full run exposed a test expecting references to be sent to the drafter. It now checks that the provider never receives them.

Earlier browser runs rejected changing source or exhausted the temporary storage quota. The paid rehearsal was repeated on disk. The OCR rehearsal fingerprints predate the test-only privacy assertion update.
